name: Turkish Airlines student fares
summary: Student fares with 40kg baggage and discounts on international flights for Miles&Smiles member students aged 12 to 34.
key: A 15% student discount awaits you on flights between two destinations outside of Türkiye.
who: Students aged 12 to 34 (who have not yet turned 35) for international flights.
Only Miles&Smiles member students are eligible.
how: Create a Miles&Smiles membership, then upload documents proving your student status.
catches: Student status expires after one year.
Tickets bought with the Student passenger type include a 40kg baggage allowance.
